messages:
Jordan: observed a new class of parse failures on the raven-lite-int8 canary. looks like token splice boundaries after retries.
Sam: minimal example?
Jordan: model returned two stitched fragments: `{"tool":"lookup","args":[{"id":123` then next fragment `,"meta":"user"}]}` -> missing bracket between fragments.
Nina: this feels like streaming splicing when a replica switch happens mid-token. quantized tokenization shifts token boundaries, so an EOS or comma can be encoded differently.
Lee: is this on route TTL timeouts or client disconnects?
Jordan: route TTL = 120ms for this run. agent issues retry quickly; second replica may resume producing with no delimiter.
Maria: CI-Bot summary: canary #7: parse_failures 29/400, retry_rate 5.9%, p95 latency 180ms.
CI-Bot: canary/raven-lite-int8 #7 completed. artifacts at s3://canary/raven-lite-int8/7/.
Akiko: proposal: seam-injection at retry boundary (write a safe token like "\n--SEAM--\n") so downstream parser can detect and attempt safe merge.
Sam: agree for short term. Also add conservative TTL bump to 220ms for int8 canaries.
Nina: add telemetry flags: seam_injected, ndjson_fallback_used, replica_id, retry_idx. we need to correlate replica_id with higher splice rates.
Lee: on NDJSON fallback: we should only enable per-route opt-in; it can hide real truncation bugs otherwise.
Maria: I'll add a dashboard panel showing seam_injected rate and ndjson_fallback_count per-model.
Jordan: engineering tasks: Jordan -> bump canary TTL to 220ms; Sam -> implement seam injection + parser glue; Akiko -> add opt-in header for NDJSON fallback; Nina -> expand telemetry schema to include replica_id and retry_idx.
Sam: parser change: if parse fails and raw contains multiple top-level "{" occurrences, attempt NDJSON split and prefer last full JSON object, log fallback. make fallback gated by route header.
Akiko: for splice detection also try a cheap heuristic: if last char of first fragment is not whitespace or an expected delimiter, mark as mid-token and trigger seam heuristics.
Nina: also capture token-level offsets from tokenizer for offending outputs; that will help correlate quant boundaries with splice points.
Jordan: reproducibility: run `./tools/canary_sim --model raven-lite-int8 --seed 73 --concurrency 4 --ttl 120` and grep for "PARSE_FAIL". attach logs to the CL.
CI-Bot: CL 4521 pushed: ttl bump to 220ms for raven-lite-int8 canary.
Maria: ping when CL lands, I'll wire up the dashboard and add an alert for ndjson_fallback_rate > 0.1%.
Sam: prototype seam token: write "\n--SEAM--\n" on retry boundary; parser treats it as safe boundary anchor and attempts to join surrounding fragments by inserting a comma if needed. pushing draft.
Lee: good. keep retry budget low during canary so we don't flood replicas and create more splices.
Jordan: thanks. we'll reconvene after next canary run. :thumbsup:
